item.title: Minimizing data requirements for chemical and material property prediction via cluster-based training set selection
item.content:encoded:
Nature Computational Science, Published online: 18 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01076-9

A survey of 100 algorithms across 60 chemical and materials property prediction tasks finds that cluster-based selection of training data outperforms active learning, and a theoretical framework establishes why this occurs in the low-data limit.
